name: Otis
source: Although more cheerful than Ecout would have expected when this eccentric young man was freed from a state prison, finding freedom might be a good enough reason to put on a smile. And yet, if only because of inhuman features of likes never seen before, Ecout can't bring himself to see him as an ordinary person.
